record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Let LLEX_z = H ◦ LWEYL_z be the old-fashioned left-hand extension ideal built from operators factoring through Hilbert spaces. Determine whether (LWEYL_{2,∞})APP_{2,∞}, or even the smaller ideal LAPP_{1,∞}, fails to be contained in LLEX_{1,∞}.

evidence.quote: Referring to [32, Sections 6.6, 7.1, and 15.6], we define the quasi-Banach operator ideal LLEX_z := H ◦ LWEYL_z, where the symbol LEX stands for left-hand extention.
Problem 24. Show that (LWEYL_{2,∞})APP_{2,∞}, or even LAPP_{1,∞}, is not included in LLEX_{1,∞}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and notation. Work in the category of all bounded linear operators between Banach spaces. For an operator ideal $\mathcal A$, denote by $\mathcal A(X,Y)$ its component on a pair $(X,Y)$. Write $\mathrm H$ for the operator ideal of operators that factor through a Hilbert space. For $0 < p < \infty$ and $0 < q \le \infty$, the Lorentz scale of approximation numbers gives the (quasi-Banach) ideal $\mathrm{APP}_{p,q}$ of operators $T$ whose approximation numbers $(a_n(T))$ lie in the Lorentz sequence space $\ell_{p,q}$. The Weyl-number ideal $\mathrm{WEYL}_{p,q}$ is defined analogously via Weyl numbers, and the "left-Weyl" ideal $\mathrm{LWEYL}_{p,q}$ is defined by requiring that for every operator $S$ from a Banach space into a Hilbert space, the composition with $T$ lies in $\mathrm{WEYL}_{p,q}$ (equivalently, $\mathrm{LWEYL}_{p,q} = \mathrm{WEYL}_{p,q} \circ \mathrm H^{-1}$ in the appropriate sense). Likewise define $\mathrm{LAPP}_{p,q}$ from $\mathrm{APP}_{p,q}$. For an index $z = (p,q)$, set
$$\mathrm{LLEX}_z := \mathrm H \circ \mathrm{LWEYL}_z,$$
the left-hand extension ideal.

Problem. Show that the product ideal $(\mathrm{LWEYL}_{2,\infty}) \circ \mathrm{APP}_{2,\infty}$, and even the smaller ideal $\mathrm{LAPP}_{1,\infty}$, fails to be contained in $\mathrm{LLEX}_{1,\infty}$. That is, exhibit operators in these ideals that do not admit factorizations of the form required by $\mathrm H \circ \mathrm{LWEYL}_{1,\infty}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in a 2023 survey on traces on operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces. No subsequent work was found resolving the non-inclusion of $\mathrm{LAPP}_{1,\infty}$ (or the larger product ideal) in $\mathrm{LLEX}_{1,\infty}$, so the problem appears to remain open.
